Privacy

You can allow or disable visit statistics on this site.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Google Analytics 4 loads only with your consent and measures page views, source-link clicks, filter use and the opening of timeline entries.

We do not send the text of on-site searches to analytics. Advertising personalisation and Google Signals are disabled in the tracking code. Your choice is stored in your browser. You can change it using the Cookie preferences button on this page. When analytics is disabled, the site deletes the _ga cookies it can access.
